In situations where there is also volume depletion, such as in
use of diuretics, there is both a ﬂ uid loss and a subsequent
decrease in K levels. To maintain serum K levels within a
safe range, the kidney will excrete H in exchange for K. Even 
though K may increase, the loss of H results in generation of 
more bicarbonate. Th is further contributes to alkalosis.
